verses.original: δὲ Ἀναβλέψας εἶδεν τοὺς πλουσίους βάλλοντας τὰ αὐτῶν δῶρα εἰς τὸ γαζοφυλάκιον
verses.transliteration: de Anablepsas eiden tous plousious ballontas ta autōn dōra eis to gazophylakion
verses.literal: Then [Jesus] looked up [and] saw the rich putting - their gifts into the treasury

verses.original: δέ εἶδεν τινα πενιχρὰν χήραν βάλλουσαν ἐκεῖ δύο λεπτὰ
verses.transliteration: de eiden tina penichran chēran ballousan ekei dyo lepta
verses.literal: and He saw a poor widow put in two small copper coins

verses.original: Ἀληθῶς λέγω ὑμῖν Καὶ εἶπεν ὅτι αὕτη ἡ πτωχὴ ἡ χήρα ἔβαλεν πλεῖον πάντων
verses.transliteration: Alēthōs legō hymin Kai eipen hoti hautē hē ptōchē hē chēra ebalen pleion pantōn
verses.literal: Truly I tell you - He said - this - poor - widow has put in more than all [the others]

verses.original: γὰρ πάντες οὗτοι ἔβαλον εἰς τὰ δῶρα ἐκ αὐτοῖς τοῦ περισσεύοντος δὲ αὕτη ἐκ αὐτῆς τοῦ ὑστερήματος ἔβαλεν πάντα τὸν ὃν εἶχεν βίον
verses.transliteration: gar pantes houtoi ebalon eis ta dōra ek autois tou perisseuontos de hautē ek autēs tou hysterēmatos ebalen panta ton hon eichen bion
verses.literal: For they all . . . contributed . . . . . . . . . out of their - surplus but she out of her - poverty has put in all - - she had to live on

verses.original: Καί τινων λεγόντων περὶ ὅτι τοῦ ἱεροῦ κεκόσμηται καλοῖς λίθοις καὶ ἀναθήμασιν εἶπεν
verses.transliteration: Kai tinōn legontōn peri hoti tou hierou kekosmētai kalois lithois kai anathēmasin eipen
verses.literal: As some [of the disciples] were remarking . . . how the temple was adorned with beautiful stones and consecrated gifts [Jesus] said

verses.original: Ταῦτα ἃ θεωρεῖτε ἡμέραι ἐλεύσονται ἐν αἷς οὐκ λίθος ἀφεθήσεται ἐπὶ λίθῳ ὃς οὐ καταλυθήσεται
verses.transliteration: Tauta ha theōreite hēmerai eleusontai en hais ouk lithos aphethēsetai epi lithō hos ou katalythēsetai
verses.literal: [As for] what - you see here [the] time will come vvv [when] not one stone will be left on [another] [every one] . . . will be thrown down

verses.original: Διδάσκαλε δὲ Ἐπηρώτησαν αὐτὸν λέγοντες πότε οὖν ταῦτα ἔσται καὶ τί τὸ σημεῖον ὅταν ταῦτα μέλλῃ γίνεσθαι
verses.transliteration: Didaskale de Epērōtēsan auton legontes pote oun tauta estai kai ti to sēmeion hotan tauta mellē ginesthai
verses.literal: Teacher - they asked . . . . . . when {will} . . . these things happen And what [will be] the sign [that] they are about to take place

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ εἶπεν Βλέπετε μὴ πλανηθῆτε γὰρ πολλοὶ ἐλεύσονται ἐπὶ μου τῷ ὀνόματί λέγοντες Ἐγώ εἰμι καί Ὁ καιρὸς ἤγγικεν μὴ πορευθῆτε ὀπίσω αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: de Ho eipen Blepete mē planēthēte gar polloi eleusontai epi mou tō onomati legontes Egō eimi kai Ho kairos ēngiken mē poreuthēte opisō autōn
verses.literal: - - [Jesus] answered See to it vvv that you are not deceived For many will come in My - name claiming I am [He] and The time is near {Do} not follow . . . them

verses.original: δὲ ὅταν ἀκούσητε πολέμους καὶ ἀκαταστασίας μὴ πτοηθῆτε γὰρ ταῦτα δεῖ γενέσθαι πρῶτον ἀλλ’ τὸ τέλος οὐκ εὐθέως
verses.transliteration: de hotan akousēte polemous kai akatastasias mē ptoēthēte gar tauta dei genesthai prōton all’ to telos ouk eutheōs
verses.literal: - When you hear of wars and rebellions {do} not be alarmed - These things must happen first but the end [is] not imminent

verses.original: Τότε ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς ἔθνος Ἐγερθήσεται ἐπ’ ἔθνος καὶ βασιλεία ἐπὶ βασιλείαν
verses.transliteration: Tote elegen autois ethnos Egerthēsetai ep’ ethnos kai basileia epi basileian
verses.literal: Then He told them Nation will rise against nation and kingdom against kingdom

verses.original: ἔσονται τε μεγάλοι σεισμοί καὶ λιμοὶ καὶ λοιμοὶ κατὰ τόπους τε ἔσται φόβητρά καὶ μεγάλα σημεῖα ἀπ’ οὐρανοῦ
verses.transliteration: esontai te megaloi seismoi kai limoi kai loimoi kata topous te estai phobētra kai megala sēmeia ap’ ouranou
verses.literal: There will be - great earthquakes - famines and pestilences in various places along with - fearful sights and great signs from heaven

verses.original: δὲ Πρὸ πάντων τούτων ἐπιβαλοῦσιν αὐτῶν τὰς χεῖρας ἐφ’ ὑμᾶς καὶ διώξουσιν ἕνεκεν μου τοῦ ὀνόματός παραδιδόντες εἰς τὰς συναγωγὰς καὶ φυλακάς ἀπαγομένους ἐπὶ βασιλεῖς καὶ ἡγεμόνας
verses.transliteration: de Pro pantōn toutōn epibalousin autōn tas cheiras eph’ hymas kai diōxousin heneken mou tou onomatos paradidontes eis tas synagōgas kai phylakas apagomenous epi basileis kai hēgemonas
verses.literal: But before all [this] they will seize . . . . . . . . . . . . you and persecute [you] On account of My - name they will deliver you to the synagogues and prisons [and] they will bring [you] before kings and governors

verses.original: ἀποβήσεται ὑμῖν εἰς μαρτύριον
verses.transliteration: apobēsetai hymin eis martyrion
verses.literal: This will be your opportunity . . . to serve as witnesses

verses.original: οὖν θέτε ἐν ὑμῶν ταῖς καρδίαις μὴ προμελετᾶν ἀπολογηθῆναι
verses.transliteration: oun thete en hymōn tais kardiais mē promeletan apologēthēnai
verses.literal: So make up - your - mind not to worry beforehand how to defend yourselves

verses.original: γὰρ ἐγὼ δώσω ὑμῖν στόμα καὶ σοφίαν ᾗ οὐ ἅπαντες οἱ ἀντικείμενοι ὑμῖν δυνήσονται ἀντιστῆναι ἢ ἀντειπεῖν
verses.transliteration: gar egō dōsō hymin stoma kai sophian hē ou hapantes hoi antikeimenoi hymin dynēsontai antistēnai ē anteipein
verses.literal: For I will give you speech and wisdom that none of . . . vvv your adversaries . . . will be able to resist [or] contradict

verses.original: δὲ Παραδοθήσεσθε καὶ ὑπὸ γονέων καὶ ἀδελφῶν καὶ συγγενῶν καὶ φίλων καὶ ἐξ ὑμῶν θανατώσουσιν
verses.transliteration: de Paradothēsesthe kai hypo goneōn kai adelphōn kai syngenōn kai philōn kai ex hymōn thanatōsousin
verses.literal: - You will be betrayed even by parents and brothers and relatives and friends and [some] of you will be put to death

verses.original: καὶ ἔσεσθε μισούμενοι ὑπὸ πάντων διὰ μου τὸ ὄνομά
verses.transliteration: kai esesthe misoumenoi hypo pantōn dia mou to onoma
verses.literal: And you will be hated by everyone because of My - name

verses.original: καὶ οὐ μὴ θρὶξ ἐκ ὑμῶν τῆς κεφαλῆς ἀπόληται
verses.transliteration: kai ou mē thrix ek hymōn tēs kephalēs apolētai
verses.literal: Yet vvv not even a hair of your - head will perish

verses.original: ἐν ὑμῶν τῇ ὑπομονῇ κτήσασθε ὑμῶν τὰς ψυχὰς
verses.transliteration: en hymōn tē hypomonē ktēsasthe hymōn tas psychas
verses.literal: By your - patient endurance you will gain your - souls

verses.original: δὲ Ὅταν ἴδητε Ἰερουσαλήμ κυκλουμένην ὑπὸ στρατοπέδων τότε γνῶτε ὅτι αὐτῆς ἡ ἐρήμωσις ἤγγικεν
verses.transliteration: de Hotan idēte Ierousalēm kykloumenēn hypo stratopedōn tote gnōte hoti autēs hē erēmōsis ēngiken
verses.literal: But when you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies - you will know that her - desolation is near

verses.original: τότε οἱ ἐν τῇ Ἰουδαίᾳ φευγέτωσαν εἰς τὰ ὄρη καὶ οἱ ἐν αὐτῆς μέσῳ ἐκχωρείτωσαν καὶ οἱ ἐν ταῖς χώραις μὴ εἰσερχέσθωσαν εἰς αὐτήν
verses.transliteration: tote hoi en tē Ioudaia pheugetōsan eis ta orē kai hoi en autēs mesō ekchōreitōsan kai hoi en tais chōrais mē eiserchesthōsan eis autēn
verses.literal: Then {let} those who are in - Judea flee to the mountains {let} those in vvv [the city] get out and {let} those in the country vvv stay out of vvv [the city]

verses.original: ὅτι αὗταί εἰσιν ἡμέραι ἐκδικήσεως τοῦ πλησθῆναι τὰ πάντα γεγραμμένα
verses.transliteration: hoti hautai eisin hēmerai ekdikēseōs tou plēsthēnai ta panta gegrammena
verses.literal: For these are [the] days of vengeance - to fulfill - all that is written

verses.original: Οὐαὶ ἐν ἐκείναις ταῖς ἡμέραις ταῖς ἐχούσαις ἐν γαστρὶ καὶ ταῖς θηλαζούσαις γὰρ ἔσται μεγάλη ἀνάγκη ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ ὀργὴ τῷ τούτῳ λαῷ
verses.transliteration: Ouai en ekeinais tais hēmerais tais echousais en gastri kai tais thēlazousais gar estai megalē anankē epi tēs gēs kai orgē tō toutō laō
verses.literal: How miserable - those - days [will be] - [for] pregnant . . . . . . and - nursing [mothers] For there will be great distress upon the land and wrath against this people

verses.original: καὶ πεσοῦνται στόματι μαχαίρης καὶ αἰχμαλωτισθήσονται εἰς πάντα τὰ ἔθνη καὶ Ἰερουσαλὴμ ἔσται πατουμένη ὑπὸ ἐθνῶν ἄχρι οὗ καιροὶ ἐθνῶν πληρωθῶσιν
verses.transliteration: kai pesountai stomati machairēs kai aichmalōtisthēsontai eis panta ta ethnē kai Ierousalēm estai patoumenē hypo ethnōn achri hou kairoi ethnōn plērōthōsin
verses.literal: - They will fall by [the] edge of [the] sword and be led captive into all the nations And Jerusalem will be trodden down by [the] Gentiles until . . . [the] times of [the] Gentiles are fulfilled

verses.original: Καὶ ἔσονται σημεῖα ἐν ἡλίῳ καὶ σελήνῃ καὶ ἄστροις καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς συνοχὴ ἐθνῶν ἀπορίᾳ ἐν ἤχους θαλάσσης καὶ σάλου
verses.transliteration: Kai esontai sēmeia en hēliō kai selēnē kai astrois kai epi tēs gēs synochē ethnōn aporia en ēchous thalassēs kai salou
verses.literal: - There will be signs in [the] sun and moon and stars and on the earth dismay among the nations bewildered by [the] roaring of [the] sea and [the] surging of the waves

verses.original: ἀνθρώπων ἀποψυχόντων ἀπὸ φόβου καὶ προσδοκίας τῶν ἐπερχομένων τῇ οἰκουμένῃ γὰρ αἱ δυνάμεις τῶν οὐρανῶν σαλευθήσονται
verses.transliteration: anthrōpōn apopsychontōn apo phobou kai prosdokias tōn eperchomenōn tē oikoumenē gar hai dynameis tōn ouranōn saleuthēsontai
verses.literal: Men will faint from fear and anxiety over what is coming upon the earth for the powers of the heavens will be shaken

verses.original: καὶ τότε ὄψονται τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐρχόμενον ἐν νεφέλῃ μετὰ δυνάμεως καὶ πολλῆς δόξης
verses.transliteration: kai tote opsontai ton Huion tou anthrōpou erchomenon en nephelē meta dynameōs kai pollēs doxēs
verses.literal: vvv At that time they will see the Son - of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory

verses.original: δὲ τούτων ἀρχομένων γίνεσθαι ἀνακύψατε καὶ ἐπάρατε ὑμῶν τὰς κεφαλὰς διότι ὑμῶν ἡ ἀπολύτρωσις ἐγγίζει
verses.transliteration: de toutōn archomenōn ginesthai anakypsate kai eparate hymōn tas kephalas dioti hymōn hē apolytrōsis engizei
verses.literal: When these things begin to happen stand up and lift up your - heads because your - redemption is drawing near

verses.original: Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς παραβολὴν Ἴδετε τὴν συκῆν καὶ πάντα τὰ δένδρα
verses.transliteration: Kai eipen autois parabolēn Idete tēn sykēn kai panta ta dendra
verses.literal: Then [Jesus] told them a parable Look at the fig tree and all the trees

verses.original: ὅταν προβάλωσιν ἤδη βλέποντες ἀφ’ ἑαυτῶν γινώσκετε ὅτι τὸ θέρος ἐστίν ἤδη ἐγγὺς
verses.transliteration: hotan probalōsin ēdē blepontes aph’ heautōn ginōskete hoti to theros estin ēdē engys
verses.literal: When they sprout leaves . . . you can see for yourselves [and] know that - summer is . . . near

verses.original: οὕτως καὶ ὅταν ἴδητε ταῦτα γινόμενα ὑμεῖς γινώσκετε ὅτι ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐστιν ἐγγύς
verses.transliteration: houtōs kai hotan idēte tauta ginomena hymeis ginōskete hoti hē basileia tou Theou estin engys
verses.literal: So also when you see these things happening - know that the kingdom - of God is near

verses.original: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι αὕτη ἡ γενεὰ οὐ μὴ παρέλθῃ ἕως ἂν πάντα γένηται
verses.transliteration: amēn legō hymin hoti hautē hē genea ou mē parelthē heōs an panta genētai
verses.literal: Truly I tell you - this - generation vvv vvv will not pass away until . . . all [these things] have happened

verses.original: ὁ οὐρανὸς καὶ ἡ γῆ παρελεύσονται δὲ μου οἱ λόγοι οὐ μὴ παρελεύσονται
verses.transliteration: ho ouranos kai hē gē pareleusontai de mou hoi logoi ou mē pareleusontai
verses.literal: - Heaven and - earth will pass away but My - words vvv vvv will never pass away

verses.original: δὲ Προσέχετε ἑαυτοῖς μή‿ αἱ ὑμῶν καρδίαι ποτε βαρηθῶσιν ἐν κραιπάλῃ καὶ μέθῃ καὶ μερίμναις βιωτικαῖς καὶ ἐκείνη ἡ ἡμέρα ἐπιστῇ ἐφ’ ὑμᾶς αἰφνίδιος ὡς παγίς
verses.transliteration: de Prosechete heautois mē hai hymōn kardiai pote barēthōsin en kraipalē kai methē kai merimnais biōtikais kai ekeinē hē hēmera epistē eph’ hymas aiphnidios hōs pagis
verses.literal: But watch yourselves or . . . your hearts vvv will be weighed down by dissipation - drunkenness and [the] worries of life and that - day will spring upon you suddenly like a snare

verses.original: γὰρ ἐπεισελεύσεται ἐπὶ πάντας τοὺς καθημένους ἐπὶ πρόσωπον πάσης τῆς γῆς
verses.transliteration: gar epeiseleusetai epi pantas tous kathēmenous epi prosōpon pasēs tēs gēs
verses.literal: For it will come upon all who dwell on the face of all the earth

verses.original: δὲ ἀγρυπνεῖτε ἐν παντὶ καιρῷ δεόμενοι ἵνα κατισχύσητε ἐκφυγεῖν πάντα ταῦτα τὰ μέλλοντα γίνεσθαι καὶ σταθῆναι ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ Υἱοῦ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου
verses.transliteration: de agrypneite en panti kairō deomenoi hina katischysēte ekphygein panta tauta ta mellonta ginesthai kai stathēnai emprosthen tou Huiou tou anthrōpou
verses.literal: [So] keep watch at all times [and] pray that you may have the strength to escape all - that is about to happen and to stand before the Son - of Man

verses.original: δὲ τὰς ἡμέρας Ἦν διδάσκων ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ δὲ τὰς νύκτας ἐξερχόμενος ηὐλίζετο εἰς τὸ ὄρος τὸ καλούμενον Ἐλαιῶν
verses.transliteration: de tas hēmeras Ēn didaskōn en tō hierō de tas nyktas exerchomenos ēulizeto eis to oros to kaloumenon Elaiōn
verses.literal: - [Every] day [Jesus] taught at the temple but [every] evening He went out to spend the night on the Mount - of Olives

verses.original: καὶ ὤρθριζεν πρὸς αὐτὸν πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ἀκούειν αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ
verses.transliteration: kai ōrthrizen pros auton pas ho laos akouein autou en tō hierō
verses.literal: And early in the morning - - all the people {would come} to hear Him at the temple
